replication.target_description: Menstruation intensity of emotion, DV2, identified by the p. 41 Table 9b locator.

n.sample_role: Participants in two mutually exclusive between-subject menstrual temporal-perspective conditions: anticipation 112 and retrospection 109.
n.exclusions: Main manuscript analytic sample after general funneling, before the supplementary additional exclusions. Only female participants comfortable with menstruation questions proceeded (p. 28). General funneling excludes inability to mentally time travel (2) or write a contemplated/recalled scenario (2), p. 38. Additional exclusion analysis is separately reported in supplementary pp. 51–58.
n.location: Main manuscript p. 39, Table 8b, Menstruation, Anticipation and Retrospection N columns; p. 41 Table 9b target test

notes: Identity assessed from supplied canonical text: cover identifies Lau Tsz Chin, University of Hong Kong, 2020, title Van Boven and Ashworth (2007): Replication and extension, supervisor Dr. Gilad Feldman; provenance header names https://osf.io/ns26x and Cherry LAU Thesis Final Report.pdf. Page 3 gives the exact target original title and DOI 10.1037/0096-3445.136.2.289. This is a primary completed thesis report with methods, results and supplementary results, not a preregistration or secondary article. No PDF was supplied. Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders only. Analytic N derivation for the located main-manuscript test: 112 anticipation participants + 109 retrospection participants = 221 distinct participants. Conditions were randomly assigned (p. 28), and independent-sample t-tests used (p. 49). This is not recruitment N = 601, not a df-derived N, and not two repeated measurements of the same people. Main manuscript p. 37 explicitly labels its analysis pre-exclusion; p. 38 documents general funneling already applied. Supplementary p. 51 separately prints post-exclusion menstruation N = 128; supplementary p. 52 gives 64 + 64 = 128, and p. 58 reports different tests. These additional-exclusion results are not substituted into the p. 40–41 main-manuscript tests.
